name: slack
description: Read, react, and mark-read a Slack workspace via the Slack Web API. List unread DMs, group DMs, @-mentions, channel unreads, and unread thread replies (muted conversations skipped), show a message with its permalink, read recent thread/channel history, add an emoji reaction, and mark a conversation or thread read. No browser; reply drafting is handled separately by the message-draft skill.
